rules.action: Opens the menu and focuses the first item (ArrowDown on an already open menu just focuses the first item).
Opens the menu and focuses the last item (on an already open menu it just focuses the last item).
Moves to the next enabled item.
From the last item wraps to the first.
From the first item wraps to the last.
Activates the focused item and closes.
Closes and returns focus to the trigger; pressed on the trigger while the menu is open it also closes (reason `escape`) and focus stays there.

Closes; Tab moves focus to the tabbable element after the trigger, Shift+Tab to the one before it, in document order (the anchor stands in for the trigger when there is none). The key is not prevented: the menu sets every item to tabindex -1 and moves focus to the trigger, so the browser's own Tab continues from there and a popup a controlled parent still shows holds no tab stop (web and Lit alike). With `anchor`, focus is parked on the anchor when it is focusable; otherwise the menu prevents the key and focuses the first tabbable after (Tab) or the last before (Shift+Tab) the anchor in document order, excluding its descendants.

Typeahead — moves to the next enabled item whose label starts with the typed characters. Any single printable character counts (letters of any script and digits, not only a–z), compared case-insensitively; Space stays activation, and keys held with Ctrl, Meta or Alt are ignored.
